product: VMware Cloud Foundation Operations for Networks
path_note: The specification declares `servers: [{url: /api/ni}]`. Every request path below is the server base path concatenated with the path item, e.g. POST http://<host>:<port>/api/ni/auth/token. Requests carry no query string.

security.note: Every operation is protected by ApiKeyAuth except `create`, which declares `security: []` in the specification. The `create` request MUST NOT carry an Authorization header.

rules: A property whose value is not set MUST be omitted from the request body entirely. It MUST NOT be emitted as JSON null, as an empty string, as an empty object, or as an empty array.
A property that IS set MUST be emitted even when its value is the empty string. Set-but-empty is not the same as unset.
An object-valued property (for example `domain`) is omitted in full when it is unset; it is never emitted as `{}`.
No request body may contain a JSON null anywhere.
Property names on the wire are the snake_case names given in the specification, not the client's own field or parameter names.

domain_type.description: domain type, should be in uppercase

value.description: domain value, not required for LOCAL domain

action_type.description: Type of Bulk Action to perform

success_count.description: Total Count of Successful data sources

failed_count.description: Total Count of Failed data sources

async_workflow.description: `bulkDataSourceOperation` answers 202 Submitted the moment the request is accepted. The 202 body carries only `request_id`; it carries no result. The bulk operation continues server-side after the response is written, so its outcome MUST be obtained by polling `getBulkOperationDetails` with that `request_id`. A 202 MUST NOT be treated as completion, and the first `getBulkOperationDetails` response MUST NOT be assumed terminal.
async_workflow.terminal_condition: BulkOperationReportResponse reports progress as counts. The operation has reached a terminal state when, and only when, `success_count + failed_count == total_count` and `total_count > 0`. Until then the report is a partial snapshot and the client must poll again.
polling_requirements: Poll `getBulkOperationDetails` on a bounded interval until the terminal condition holds.
Return the terminal report - the partial snapshots are intermediate state and must not be returned.
Stop polling once the terminal condition holds; do not keep polling a finished operation.
Bound the wait with a timeout and fail loudly if the terminal condition is not reached in time.
Every poll carries the ApiKeyAuth Authorization header.

closed_world.note: This contract names every operation the client is permitted to call. A request to any other path is a contract violation, including convenience probes such as fetching a task/status URL that the contract does not define, or re-reading a data source list to infer completion.
